verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity platform, so the axis applies. However, the only deployment option in evidence is Auth0 Private Cloud, described as a dedicated, managed cloud service run by Auth0 on AWS or Azure. That is a vendor-managed isolated tenant, not customer self-hosting, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit. Community comments praise competitors like FusionAuth for offering self-hosting, which implies Auth0 does not.
